claims.summary: In the setting of lem:discrete-flow-bound (X_1..X_N i.i.d. uniform on [0,1]^2, one dyadic sequence delta_0 = 2^(-J) >= 4 sqrt(log N/N), D(g) = sum_Q (n_Q - N delta_0^2) g_Q, v_e = |Delta_e g|/delta_0), on the event of its part (a): (a) for every pair alpha in [2,infinity]^2 and every grid function g with sum_e w_e <= 2, w_e = delta_0^2 psi*_alpha_d(e)(v_e/2), |D(g)| <= (3/4) L_0 sqrt(N log N)(46 + 6 sum over edges with v_e >= 2e^16 of w_e (log v_e)^(1/2 - 1/alpha_d(e))); (b) at (4,4) every nested chain g = delta_0 sum_{k <= K} y_k 1_{A_k} (any heights y_k > 0, any K) with sum_e w_e <= 2 has v_e = sum of y_k over the boundaries through e, so (a) applies; at one height y, with m_e the number of boundaries through e and any M >= 1, if the edges with m_e > M carry cost at most eta, |D(g)| <= (3/4) L_0 sqrt(N log N)(46 + 12 (log max{M y, 2e^16})^(1/4) + 6 eta (log max{m_max y, 2e^16})^(1/4)).
claims.assessment: Working proof: lem:discrete-flow-bound (a) and its proof's per-edge comparison of psi_2* with psi*_alpha (lem:flow-coarea-level-bound (b)), summed with the per-edge logarithm instead of its maximum; for chains, nesting makes each increment m_e y delta_0. A refinement of lem:discrete-flow-bound (b) with no new step.
claims.rationale: The retained chain test's open instance loses only on its bundles: a bundle is charged by the cost it carries, so chains at a bounded height whose bundles carry cost eta with eta (log(m_max y))^(1/4) bounded are at the conjectured order at every number of layers; with lem:multilevel-chain-bound it narrows the record's smallest open case to bundled length fractions between (log N)^(-1/4) and (log N)^(-1/16), without deciding it.
claims.next_action: The owed spread bound (reviewer's form, unverified): move each bundle's layers apart one cell per layer, bound the spread chain by the nested clause and the remainder in tubes of width m delta_0 by a tube bound for functions of the form of lem:tube-localized-discrepancy (a).
